svg.title: Card Gate Frame — Ornament, by design.
svg.desc: Six real generation 3 SVG frames: Courtyard on ivory, Fleuron in gold on forest green, Arcade in copper on limestone, Vine on sage, Fan in silver on midnight blue, and Volute in rose gold on burgundy. The typography and backgrounds illustrate possible uses of the library.
svg.text: Six families. A seed of your own.

g.text: Stories with a sense of place.

svg.text: Seeded geometry / DOM-free core / Zero runtime dependencies
